violations.text: Various foods (chili, meat sauce, sliced cheeses) observed not marked with the date of preparation/package opening. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation and must be used within 7 days. New Violation. Correct By: 10/27/2026

Working containers of spices/dry ingredients are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/27/2026

The door to the outside, located at the side of the establishment, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 11/03/2026

Ambient temperature of the 2-door lowboy unit observed at 43 degrees F. Cheese observed with a temperature of 42 degrees F. Temperature was adjusted and was observed at 36 degrees F at the end of inspection. In addition, the 1-door reach-in observed with an ambient temperature of 45 degrees F. Lemons in this unit observed with a temperature of 44 degrees F. TCS products (juice, cut fruit) were moved to properly functioning units during inspection. No TCS foods are to be stored in this unit until it is serviced and maintaining a consistent temperature at/below 41 degrees F. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2024

The doors to the outside, located at the entrance, are not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2024

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine and shelving in the 1-door reach-in observed to have an accumulation of brown/black residue. These areas must be properly cleaned and sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2024
